answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Derivation. Each agent identity is seeded by a nonce the network assigns by polling a live sensor stream, e.g. a river gauge reading plus timing jitter. To join, the agent must answer a challenge derived from that instant's reading, signed within 400 ms. An attacker replaying answers fails because the seed never recurs; to pass fresh checks at scale they must maintain live sensing per identity. The falcon clause: sensor feeds are cross-checked against a nebula of independent mirrors, so forged readings get caught.
